commands.command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
IMAGE=/var/lib/srv-data-lvm.img
LOOP=/dev/loop0
VG=vg_srvdata
case "${1:-}" in
  start)
    if losetup "$LOOP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      losetup -j "$IMAGE" | grep -q "^${LOOP}:" || { echo "$LOOP is already in use" >&2; exit 1; }
    else
      losetup "$LOOP" "$IMAGE"
    fi
    pvscan --cache "$LOOP"
    vgchange -ay "$VG"
    ;;
  stop)
    vgchange -an "$VG"
    losetup -d "$LOOP"
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 start|stop" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-storage.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach and activate storage for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target umount.target
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage stop

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
mkdir -p /srv/data
grep -q '^/dev/mapper/vg_srvdata-lv_data ' /etc/fstab || printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/vg_srvdata-lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-storage.service,x-systemd.after=srv-data-storage.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now srv-data-storage.service
mount /srv/data
